limitations: No live service, database or container access
Existing JS policy results are reported, not rerun; Python independently cross-checks durable original responses and accepted bid effect counts
Protocol p95 reference target is separate from the load harness correctness/condition PASS
Resource observations are coarse samples and cannot establish true maximum queues, lock waits or CPU peaks
Window timestamps are estimated from existing server/elapsed samples; resources near boundaries may be assigned to an adjacent phase

runs.scope: PROTOCOL_INTENT_TO_FINAL_RESPONSE; excludes DOM/render latency and ack completion; no production capacity conclusion

conditions.conditionLimit: 500ms scheduled slot fidelity, not an operational performance target
conditions.extraMonitoringOverhead: One /metrics request every15s plus socket state checks each500ms; root separately samples2HTTP+SQL+dockerstats every15s
